Direktstrecke A → B über das Laserscan-P: Direct link A → B over the laser-scan profile (2 m steps, corridor ±3 m). Seven model families on identical Monte Carlo draws: ITU-R P.1812-6 (port of the official reference implementation, 63 validation cases to 5·10⁻⁸ dB), the same with terminal clutter eq. (64), buildings as edges + vegetation per P.833-10, terrain only + P.2108-1, delta-Bullington, P.1411-12 (up to 660 m), log-distance. Plus P.2109-2 for window/building entry loss, noise kTB + noise figure + interference level, LoRa threshold per preset (SX1262).
Direktstrecke zwischen zwei Punkten, mit: Direct link between two points, computed over the laser scan with all model families. The result is on the right under “Details”.
